items.text: Christine McGovern is a real estate small business owner who has lived in the Southland area for 29 years. She previously served on the Local School Council for the Annie Keller Gifted School. Her campaign says she initiated "Back the Blue" in Chicago and organized a "Reopen Illinois" team supporting local businesses. McGovern supports fiscal responsibility and a balanced budget.
Her campaign says she supports legislation providing better health care to seniors, veterans and people with mental illnesses, as well as youth programs to address the drug crisis and crime.
